core_capabilities: Create persisted feed posts, event announcements, or articles with optional media and engage with posts by liking, commenting, reposting, quoting, or sending them in a message.

Maintain a professional profile by updating introductory, about, and contact information and adding or removing experience, education, career breaks, certifications, projects, skills, languages, publications, awards, and other credentials.
Build a professional network by sending personalized connection requests, accepting or ignoring incoming invitations, withdrawing sent requests, and dismissing suggestions.
Browse recommended jobs and persistently mark a selected job as applied.
Search existing conversations, send persisted messages, and start a new conversation with another member.
secondary_capabilities: Search globally across members by name and feed posts by content, then open a matching profile or locate a matching post in the feed.

Select a resume file to populate otherwise-empty profile sections with persisted default experience, education, skills, certification, and about data, without claiming that the file contents are parsed.
Persist a preferred profile language and custom public-profile URL.
Copy a shareable profile link and download the generated profile export as a .pdf file.
Review notifications and persistently mark unread notifications as read.
Edit and persist a company page's logo, overview, website, industry, size, type, phone, founding year, and specialties.

Configure and persist whether members can message the company page and which conversation topics they can choose, then filter company inbox conversations and send persisted replies from the company account.
Review company-page activity by all events, comments, mentions, reactions, reposts, or analytics.
Inspect the company analytics dashboard for content, visitors, followers, search appearances, leads, and competitors and adjust the displayed date range and metrics.
Add company administrators, change their roles, or remove them.

Restore every masked restoration stage identified below.

Restore the My Network workflow that lets a user select a suggested person, add a personalized note, and send them a connection request.

Restore the My Network workflow that lets a user retract a pending connection invitation they previously sent, persisting the change and updating the network view accordingly.
